summary: PM6a: shared Sdk pieces: Git hooks, IGitHubApi, Markdown, charts, people picker, drag and drop
description:
Landed in:
- DevHub `77e5277`: PM6a: shared pieces for plugins in the Sdk — contracts IRepositoryEvents, ICommitMessageSuggester, IGitDecorator (Integration/GitIntegration.cs) and IGitHubApi (no token handed out); Sdk.Core Markdown parser, ChartData/ChartMath, Person/PeopleSearch, ListMoves (68 new tests); controls MarkdownView (safe links only), LineChart/BarChart/PieChart (Brush.Chart.1-6 tokens, legend, tooltips), ItemsDragDrop (boards: nested lists, insertion line), TreeDragDrop moved from Templates, PeoplePicker; all in the UI Gallery (checked in Light and Dark, drag and picker driven by input); docs (PLUGINS §6, UI_GUIDE components and gotchas)
